blocks.text: SexBomb Girls member Cynthia Yapchingco is mourning the death of her partner, concert producer Susan O. Lim. In a social media post on Saturday, Sept. 26, Yapchingco shared a solo photo of Lim and a photo from their wedding as she paid tribute to her late wife. “No words could ever capture what she meant to me… or the heartbreak of saying goodbye,” Yapchingco wrote. “One of my greatest blessings will always be our love and journey of us together.” Yapchingco recalled how their relationship endured “for better or for worse” and described laughter as healing and love as “the greatest […]...
